links.comparator_used: Baseline configurations without query rewriting (original query)
links.effect: Baseline concordance 79–85%; query rewriting combined with curated guideline retrieval improved concordance to 93–95% (p < 0.01). The effect of query rewriting alone is not separated in the abstract.
links.quote: Combining query rewriting with curated guideline retrieval improved concordance to 93–95% (p < 0.01), with prompt design and corpus curation exerting greater influence than model selection.

links.comparator_used: Baseline configurations with broader corpus scope (not curated guideline retrieval)
links.effect: Baseline concordance 79–85%; curated guideline retrieval combined with query rewriting improved concordance to 93–95% (p < 0.01). Corpus curation had greater influence than model selection. The effect of corpus curation alone is not separated in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Among residual discordant cases in optimal configurations, approximately 60% were clinically inappropriate recommendations, so expert oversight is still required.
links.quote: Combining query rewriting with curated guideline retrieval improved concordance to 93–95% (p < 0.01), with prompt design and corpus curation exerting greater influence than model selection.
